title: MyAwesomeProject
tagline: Decentralized coordination layer for onchain funding flows.
description: Decentralized coordination layer for onchain funding flows. Uses intent-based smart contracts to route capital across L2s, auto-manage risk, and visualize treasury health in real time. Built with modular oracles, zk proofs, and wallet-native UX to simplify DeFi ops for small teams.
